content.short: INTO is a decentralized social networking platform.
content.description: INTO is a powerful Web3 super app that brings together four core components: a secure Crypto Wallet, Web3 SocialFi capabilities, a Soulbound Token (SBT) system, and AI-powered tools. Through INTOverse, the platform strives to deliver a liberated, equitable decentralized social network that minimizes centralization and gives users more control over their data, identity, and interactions. By combining financial, social, and intelligent features, INTO aims to redefine how on-chain communities connect and collaborate in a privacy-conscious, user-empowered ecosystem.
